--- /home/dastan/Recommender Systems/Abaidullah_Seikh/Project/Session 3/scripts/hw3_repeat_first.py
+++ /home/dastan/Recommender Systems/Abaidullah_Seikh/Project/Session 3/scripts/hw3_repeat_first.py
@@ -0,0 +1,230 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Pre-registered repeat-first development experiment; no model calls."""
+import csv
+from datetime import date
+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+from starter import load_data, ndcg10, scan_recent_events, validate_ranking
+from hw3_paired_analysis import apply_fallback, bootstrap, check, jsonl, sha, wtl
+
+PLAN = ROOT / 'HW3_PLAN_C_IMPROVEMENT.md'
+PLAN_HASH = 'fa99792f07dfdb8b48a63235ba8652a1aeca8a6080ac0cea0343445e69ad1402'
+METHODS = ('C', 'V1', 'V2', 'A+R', 'A', 'CBF', 'Latest buy', 'Latest buy or sell')
+WINDOWS = {
+    'main_200': ('outputs/baseline_200', 'outputs/final_200', 200,
+                 'outputs/final_200/A_responses.jsonl', 'outputs/arm_C2_200/responses.jsonl'),
+    'sparse_120': ('outputs/sparse_baseline_120', 'outputs/sparse_scores', 120,
+                   'outputs/sparse_A/responses.jsonl', 'outputs/sparse_C/responses.jsonl'),
+}
+
+
+def mean(values):
+    return sum(values) / len(values)
+
+
+def saved_baselines(folder, users):
+    groups = {}
+    with (folder / 'predictions.csv').open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
+        for row in csv.DictReader(stream):
+            groups.setdefault(row['method'], {}).setdefault(row['user_id'], []).append(
+                (int(row['rank']), row['ISIN']))
+    result = {}
+    for label, method in (('CBF', 'cbf'), ('Latest buy', 'latest_buy'),
+                           ('Latest buy or sell', 'latest_buy_or_sell')):
+        result[label] = {}
+        for uid in users:
+            rows = sorted(groups[method][uid])
+            check([rank for rank, _ in rows] == list(range(1, 11)), 'baseline ranking count mismatch')
+            result[label][uid] = [asset for _, asset in rows]
+    return result
+
+
+def repeat_first(context, base_order, latest, variant):
+    # User clarified before diagnostics: promote repeats from all 50 candidates.
+    # Complete the 10-item model order with starter candidate order for tie-breaking.
+    candidate_ids = [asset['id'] for asset in context['candidate_assets']]
+    counts = {asset['id']: asset['buy_count'] for asset in context['history']}
+    extended = base_order + [isin for isin in candidate_ids if isin not in base_order]
+    position = {isin: index for index, isin in enumerate(extended)}
+    repeats = [isin for isin in candidate_ids if isin in counts]
+    check(all(isin in latest for isin in repeats), 'repeat candidate missing pre-cutoff Buy date')
+    if variant == 'V1':
+        key = lambda isin: (-date.fromisoformat(latest[isin]).toordinal(), -counts[isin], position[isin])
+    else:
+        key = lambda isin: (-counts[isin], -date.fromisoformat(latest[isin]).toordinal(), position[isin])
+    ranking = sorted(repeats, key=key)[:10]
+    for isin in base_order:
+        if len(ranking) == 10:
+            break
+        if isin not in ranking:
+            ranking.append(isin)
+    return validate_ranking(ranking, candidate_ids)
+
+
+def evaluate(name, specification):
+    baseline_rel, destination_rel, n, a_rel, c_rel = specification
+    baseline, destination = ROOT / baseline_rel, ROOT / destination_rel
+    protocol = json.loads((baseline / 'protocol.json').read_text())
+    contexts = jsonl(baseline / 'contexts.jsonl')
+    users = [ctx['user_id'] for ctx in contexts]
+    check(len(users) == len(set(users)) == n and users == protocol['users'], 'cohort mismatch')
+    data = ROOT.parent / 'Session 1/FAR-Trans'
+    for filename, expected in protocol['source_sha256'].items():
+        check(sha(data / filename) == expected, 'dataset source hash mismatch')
+    horizon = (date.fromisoformat(protocol['end_exclusive']) - date.fromisoformat(protocol['cutoff'])).days
+    assets, _, history, future, end, _ = load_data(data, protocol['cutoff'], horizon)
+    check(end == protocol['end_exclusive'] and sorted(assets) == protocol['eligible_assets'],
+          'truth protocol reconstruction mismatch')
+    # Recency comes from the starter's own pre-cutoff-only event result; counts
+    # and the universe of previously bought assets come from frozen contexts.
+    events = scan_recent_events(data, protocol['cutoff'], assets)
+    latest = {}
+    for ctx in contexts:
+        uid = ctx['user_id']
+        counts = {asset['id']: asset['buy_count'] for asset in ctx['history']}
+        check(counts == dict(history.get(uid, {})), 'context history differs from starter history')
+        last = {}
+        for timestamp, isin, kind in events.get(uid, []):
+            check(timestamp < protocol['cutoff'], 'future event encountered in repeat-first input')
+            if kind == 'Buy' and isin in counts:
+                last[isin] = max(last.get(isin, timestamp), timestamp)
+        latest[uid] = last
+    truth = {ctx['user_id']: future.get(ctx['user_id'], set()) & set(ctx['eligible_asset_ids'])
+             for ctx in contexts}
+    nonempty = [index for index, uid in enumerate(users) if truth[uid]]
+    rankings = saved_baselines(baseline, users)
+    invalid = {}
+    for arm, response in (('A', ROOT / a_rel), ('C', ROOT / c_rel)):
+        rankings[arm], invalid[arm] = apply_fallback(
+            jsonl(response), contexts, rankings['CBF'], protocol['protocol_hash'])
+    for label, source, variant in (('V1', 'C', 'V1'), ('V2', 'C', 'V2'), ('A+R', 'A', 'V1')):
+        rankings[label] = {ctx['user_id']: repeat_first(
+            ctx, rankings[source][ctx['user_id']], latest[ctx['user_id']], variant) for ctx in contexts}
+    scores = {method: [ndcg10(rankings[method][uid], truth[uid]) for uid in users] for method in METHODS}
+    baseline_metrics = json.loads((baseline / 'metrics.json').read_text())['methods']
+    for label, key in (('CBF', 'cbf'), ('Latest buy', 'latest_buy'), ('Latest buy or sell', 'latest_buy_or_sell')):
+        check(math.isclose(mean(scores[label]), baseline_metrics[key]['ndcg_at_10'], abs_tol=1e-15),
+              'baseline score sanity mismatch')
+    for arm in ('A', 'C'):
+        evaluation = destination / (f'evaluation_{arm}' if name == 'main_200' else arm)
+        metrics = json.loads((evaluation / 'metrics.json').read_text())
+        check(math.isclose(mean(scores[arm]), metrics['methods']['custom']['ndcg_at_10'], abs_tol=1e-15),
+              'official arm score sanity mismatch')
+        check(len(invalid[arm]) == len(metrics['custom_failures']), 'official fallback count mismatch')
+
+    repeat_truth_users = 0
+    new_truth_users = 0
+    repeat_truth_in_pool = 0
+    candidate_repeat_counts = []
+    for ctx in contexts:
+        uid = ctx['user_id']
+        bought = {asset['id'] for asset in ctx['history']}
+        candidates = {asset['id'] for asset in ctx['candidate_assets']}
+        repeated_truth = truth[uid] & bought
+        repeat_truth_users += bool(repeated_truth)
+        new_truth_users += bool(truth[uid] - bought)
+        repeat_truth_in_pool += bool(repeated_truth & candidates)
+        candidate_repeat_counts.append(len(bought & candidates))
+    result = {
+        'label': 'development results', 'window': name, 'users': n,
+        'nonempty_truth_users': len(nonempty), 'horizon_days': horizon,
+        'protocol_hash': protocol['protocol_hash'], 'plan_sha256': sha(PLAN),
+        'clarification_before_diagnostics': {
+            'scope': 'User selected: promote from all 50 candidates',
+            'ties': 'C/A top-10 order first; starter candidate order for assets absent from that ranking',
+            'remaining_slots': 'Fill from the original C/A ranking, preserving its order',
+            'recency_source': 'starter.scan_recent_events pre-cutoff Buy dates; counts from frozen contexts',
+        },
+        'diagnostics': {
+            'nonempty_users_with_repeat_truth': repeat_truth_users,
+            'nonempty_users_with_new_truth': new_truth_users,
+            'repeat_and_new_user_counts_can_overlap': True,
+            'users_with_previously_bought_candidate': sum(count > 0 for count in candidate_repeat_counts),
+            'mean_previously_bought_candidates_per_user': mean(candidate_repeat_counts),
+            'repeat_truth_users_with_repeated_truth_in_top50': repeat_truth_in_pool,
+        },
+        'official_fallbacks': {arm: len(positions) for arm, positions in invalid.items()},
+        'methods': {method: {'ndcg_at_10_all': mean(scores[method]),
+                             'ndcg_at_10_nonempty': mean([scores[method][i] for i in nonempty])}
+                    for method in METHODS},
+        'statistical_conventions': {
+            'bootstrap': f'10000 paired resamples of all {n} users; Python random.Random(0) reset for each pair; '
+                         'percentile CI with linear interpolation',
+            'wins_ties_losses': 'nonempty-truth users only; exact score equality for ties',
+            'sign_test': 'exact two-sided binomial p=0.5 on non-tied users',
+        },
+        'analysis_script_sha256': sha(Path(__file__)),
+    }
+    source_paths = [baseline / 'protocol.json', baseline / 'contexts.jsonl', baseline / 'predictions.csv',
+                    ROOT / a_rel, ROOT / c_rel, ROOT / 'starter.py', ROOT / 'scripts/hw3_paired_analysis.py']
+    result['source_sha256'] = {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(path) for path in source_paths}
+    return result, scores, nonempty
+
+
+def main():
+    check(sha(PLAN) == PLAN_HASH, 'pre-registration plan hash mismatch')
+    targets = {name: ROOT / spec[1] / 'repeat_first.json' for name, spec in WINDOWS.items()}
+    check(all(not path.exists() for path in targets.values()), 'repeat-first output exists; refusing to overwrite')
+    protected = [path for directory in ('outputs', 'cohorts', 'scripts')
+                 for path in (ROOT / directory).rglob('*') if path.is_file()]
+    protected += [path for path in ROOT.iterdir() if path.is_file() and
+                  (path.name.startswith(('HW3_PROTOCOL', 'run_hw3_')) or path == PLAN)]
+    frozen = {path: sha(path) for path in protected}
+    evaluated = {name: evaluate(name, spec) for name, spec in WINDOWS.items()}
+    main_result = evaluated['main_200'][0]['methods']
+    v1, v2 = main_result['V1']['ndcg_at_10_all'], main_result['V2']['ndcg_at_10_all']
+    check(v1 != v2, 'main V1 and V2 tie; pre-registration does not specify a tie-break, selection requires clarification')
+    chosen = 'V1' if v1 > v2 else 'V2'
+    for name, (result, scores, nonempty) in evaluated.items():
+        result['selection'] = {'chosen_C_plus_R': chosen, 'discarded_variant': 'V2' if chosen == 'V1' else 'V1',
+                               'selection_data': 'main_200 only', 'criterion': 'higher mean nDCG@10 over all 200',
+                               'main_V1_ndcg_at_10': v1, 'main_V2_ndcg_at_10': v2,
+                               'sparse_role': 'robustness check only'}
+        result['pairs'] = {}
+        for label, left, right in (('V1 - C', 'V1', 'C'), ('V2 - C', 'V2', 'C'),
+                                    ('C+R - A+R', chosen, 'A+R'),
+                                    ('C+R - Latest buy or sell', chosen, 'Latest buy or sell'),
+                                    ('C+R - A', chosen, 'A')):
+            differences = [a - b for a, b in zip(scores[left], scores[right])]
+            result['pairs'][label] = {
+                'left_method': left, 'right_method': right, 'mean_difference_all': mean(differences),
+                'bootstrap_95_ci': bootstrap(differences),
+                'nonempty_wins_ties_losses': wtl([differences[i] for i in nonempty]),
+            }
+    check(all(sha(path) == expected for path, expected in frozen.items()), 'existing protected file changed')
+    for name, (result, _, _) in evaluated.items():
+        result['protected_existing_files_checked_unchanged'] = len(frozen)
+        with targets[name].open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
+            stream.write(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
+    print(f'C+R selection: {chosen}; main V1={v1:.4f}; main V2={v2:.4f}')
+    for name, (result, _, _) in evaluated.items():
+        print(f'\n{name}: users={result["users"]}; nonempty={result["nonempty_truth_users"]}')
+        diag = result['diagnostics']
+        print(f'Repeat truth users={diag["nonempty_users_with_repeat_truth"]}; '
+              f'new truth users={diag["nonempty_users_with_new_truth"]}; '
+              f'repeated truth in top50={diag["repeat_truth_users_with_repeated_truth_in_top50"]}/'
+              f'{diag["nonempty_users_with_repeat_truth"]}')
+        print(f'Users with previously bought candidate={diag["users_with_previously_bought_candidate"]}; '
+              f'mean count={diag["mean_previously_bought_candidates_per_user"]:.4f}')
+        print('| Method | nDCG@10 all | nDCG@10 non-empty |')
+        print('| --- | ---: | ---: |')
+        for method, row in result['methods'].items():
+            print(f'| {method} | {row["ndcg_at_10_all"]:.4f} | {row["ndcg_at_10_nonempty"]:.4f} |')
+        print('| Pair | Mean difference | Bootstrap 95% CI | W/T/L non-empty | Exact sign p |')
+        print('| --- | ---: | --- | --- | ---: |')
+        for pair, row in result['pairs'].items():
+            ci, counts = row['bootstrap_95_ci'], row['nonempty_wins_ties_losses']
+            print(f'| {pair} | {row["mean_difference_all"]:.4f} | [{ci[0]:.4f}, {ci[1]:.4f}] | '
+                  f'{counts["wins"]}/{counts["ties"]}/{counts["losses"]} | {counts["sign_test_p"]:.4f} |')
+    print(f'Protected existing files unchanged: {len(frozen)}')
+    for path in (PLAN, Path(__file__), *targets.values()):
+        print(f'{path.relative_to(ROOT)} SHA-256: {sha(path)}')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

## Completed — C+R selects V2 (count-first)

The plan was saved and hashed before diagnostics or scoring. As clarified, repeats can be promoted from **all 50 candidates**, with starter candidate order resolving ties for assets absent from the model’s top 10.

**Selection used main-200 results only:** V2 **0.0386** versus V1 **0.0367**. V1 is discarded as the selected C+R variant. No model runs occurred; **78 existing files verified unchanged**.

## Diagnostics

| Aggregate | Main 200 | Sparse 120 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Non-empty-truth users | 24 | 8 |
| Users with ≥1 repeat truth asset | 18 | 2 |
| Users with ≥1 new truth asset | 13 | 6 |
| Users with a previously bought candidate | 198 | 119 |
| Mean previously bought candidates per user | 2.2000 | 1.5167 |
| Repeat-truth users with repeated truth in top 50 | 13/18 | 2/2 |

Repeat-truth and new-truth user counts may overlap.

## Development scores

| Method | Main: all 200 | Main: non-empty | Sparse: all 120 | Sparse: non-empty |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| C | 0.0282 | 0.2352 | 0.0178 | 0.2664 |
| V1 — recency | 0.0367 | 0.3060 | 0.0178 | 0.2664 |
| **V2 — selected C+R** | **0.0386** | **0.3219** | **0.0208** | **0.3125** |
| A+R — V1 | 0.0364 | 0.3031 | 0.0172 | 0.2577 |
| A | 0.0302 | 0.2514 | 0.0161 | 0.2413 |
| CBF | 0.0305 | 0.2539 | 0.0141 | 0.2116 |
| Latest buy | 0.0474 | 0.3946 | 0.0204 | 0.3058 |
| Latest buy or sell | 0.0484 | 0.4033 | 0.0221 | 0.3311 |

### Main-200 paired comparisons

1: # FAR-Trans: Encoder and Ranker baselines
2: 
3: This package provides two runnable open-weight LLM methods, **adaptations rather
4: than full paper reproductions**, with the [starter](../far-trans/README.md)'s four
5: baselines and evaluation unchanged. These are optional starting points: use the
6: approach relevant to your research question, not necessarily both. Identify your
7: own change and contribution; improvement over the baselines is not required.
8: 
9: - **Encoder:** paraphrase each asset's supplied attributes, combine original and
10:   generated text as separate TF-IDF views, then match assets to a user's past Buy
11:   history. Compare `llmrec_encoder` with `original_text_cbf`. Inspired by LLM-Rec's
12:   basic `p_para` prompt; this uses TF-IDF instead of its text encoder/trained MLP.
13: - **Ranker:** show the LLM past Buy counts, dated recent purchases, the explicit
14:   most recent Buy, and fixed CBF candidates; ask it to return ten original ISINs.
15:   Compare `llmrank` with `candidate_order_first10` on identical candidates.
16:   This adapts LLMRank's sequential/recency prompting, without ICL, bootstrapping,
17:   or multi-permutation aggregation.
18: 
19: This README is the primary GitHub guide. Continue with [From HW1 to HW2](HW1_TO_HW2.md)
20: for questions, exact prompts, input/output formats, and paper references, and
21: [HW2 results](HW2_RESULTS.md) for the seven-method aggregate comparison.
22: The optional [HTML handout](BASELINE_GUIDE.html) must be downloaded and opened
23: locally; GitHub displays its source, not a rendered page. No GitHub Pages hosting
24: is assumed. Its Markdown companion links are plain text files when opened locally;
25: read them on GitHub or with a Markdown viewer.
26: 
27: ## Dependencies and offline behavior
28: 
29: Use Python 3.12 or a compatible Python 3 environment. Pure-function tests, imports,
30: CLI help and `--prepare-only` use the standard library; inference additionally needs
31: **torch and transformers** installed in your own environment. The optional
32: [requirements.txt](requirements.txt) preserves the measured pins. For example, in
33: a user-managed uv project use `uv add 'torch==2.11.0' 'transformers==4.57.6'`;
34: choose the appropriate torch build for your hardware. The measured CUDA wheel
35: reports `2.11.0+cu128`. Public package/index and CPU/platform wheel availability
36: must be checked in your own environment; no installation or availability test was
37: performed during packaging.
38: 
39: The measured local pilot used torch **2.11.0+cu128**, transformers **4.57.6**, and an
40: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti **Laptop GPU**, CUDA bfloat16. CUDA is not required by the
41: API; CPU uses float32 and may be much slower. The pilot required at least 5 GiB free
42: CUDA memory before starting; that is a local safety gate, **not a promise that every
43: model/workload fits in 5 GiB**. Do not use a CPU fallback for a time-bounded GPU pilot.
44: 
45: A cached model ID or local snapshot path is accepted. Loading defaults to
46: `local_files_only=True`, `trust_remote_code=False`; no teacher API or API credentials
47: are used. **The commands below assume the pinned model is already cached. On first
48: load in a fresh environment, explicitly add `--allow-download` to authorize the
49: model download**, or provide a previously downloaded snapshot with `--model`.
50: Keep `--revision 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e` when using the
51: `Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B` model ID. Subsequent cached runs omit `--allow-download` and stay
52: offline. Greedy generation disables thinking through the tokenizer chat template;
53: context budget is fixed at 8192 tokens; encoder/ranker generation budgets are
54: 160/512 tokens. No context/decoding tuning is performed here.
55: 
56: ## Quickstart
57: 
58: From the repository root, change into `project/far-trans-llm`. Replace the data path
59: with the directory **containing** `transactions.csv`, `asset_information.csv`,
60: `customer_information.csv`, and `close_prices.csv`.
61: 
62: ```bash
63: cd project/far-trans-llm
64: python ranker.py --help
65: python encoder.py --help
66: python -m unittest discover -s . -p 'test_*.py' -v
67: 
68: # Cached-model inference; add --allow-download explicitly for a first download.
69: python ranker.py \
70:   --data-dir /path/to/FAR-Trans \
71:   --output-dir outputs/my_ranker \
72:   --max-users 100 --candidate-count 50 \
73:   --model Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B \
74:   --revision 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e \
75:   --device auto --on-invalid fallback
76: 
77: python encoder.py \
78:   --data-dir /path/to/FAR-Trans \
79:   --output-dir outputs/my_encoder \
80:   --max-users 100 --candidate-count 50 \
81:   --model Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B \
82:   --revision 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e \
83:   --device auto --on-invalid fallback
84: ```
85: 
86: The default starter is the sibling `../far-trans`, resolved relative to the script,
87: not the shell's working directory; no `--starter-dir` is needed. An explicit
88: `--starter-dir ../far-trans` also works when running from this directory.
89: 
90: For prompt-only inspection, add `--prepare-only` to either command; no model is
91: loaded or downloaded, and no measured result is produced. For a three-user check,
92: use `--max-users 3` and a fresh output directory. For a bounded CUDA pilot use
93: `--device cuda` and GNU `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=2s 120s` (ranker) or
94: `300s` (encoder) before `python`. Timeout exit 124 is an incomplete experiment,
95: not a successful result; these pilot time limits do not guarantee a complete
96: 100-user run.
97: 
98: ## Data and evaluation protocol
99: 
100: Defaults: cutoff **2021-06-01 exclusive**, 30-day future Buy horizon, deterministic
101: warm-user selection using the starter's SHA256 seed 42 ordering, repeat purchases
102: allowed, and 50 CBF candidates. Selection never filters by future truth. Eligible
103: assets need pre-cutoff metadata and a positive historical close price. The starter
104: excludes exact duplicate transaction rows and reconstructed initial-position rows.
105: Same-day event ties use ISIN ordering, not invented intraday chronology. Encoder
106: candidate count does **not** reduce its full eligible corpus.
107: 
108: Retain and report **Popularity, CBF, Latest buy, and Latest buy or sell** for every
109: completed run. The starter computes binary nDCG@10, including empty-truth users as
110: zero in the all-user macro mean; its nonempty-truth mean is reported separately.
111: Do not change users per method, remove assets to finish generation, or evaluate
112: partially generated text as a completed encoder benchmark.
113: 
114: Only as-of source metadata/history/profile information enters prompts; truth is
115: kept separate. Missing values stay unknown. No future news or external lookup is
116: supplied, but real public asset names may activate a model's pretrained knowledge.
117: Generated text is **not automatically factually validated**, and these experiments
118: are not investment advice.
119: 
120: ## Outputs, failures and resumption
121: 
122: Completed runs write `predictions.csv`, `metrics.json`, `per_user.json`, and
123: `run_manifest.json`, preserving all cohort users. `generations.jsonl` records each
124: request's complete prompt/settings, raw text, tokens and generation time.
125: `generation_cache/*.json` persists each completed unique request immediately;
126: identical asset descriptions can share a cache entry, so cache-file count need not
127: equal completed-asset count. Cache keys bind prompt, model/revision and settings.
128: Ranker responses also record parse repairs, invalid outputs and fallback decisions.
129: `ranker_responses.jsonl` is append-only event history: repeated users on resume
130: are expected, not corruption. On completion, `final_responses.jsonl` contains one
131: record per current cohort user in manifest order. Runtime `response_log` points
132: to this canonical file and `history_log` points to the untouched event history.
133: 
134: The distribution contains source/tests/documentation only, not models, data,
135: caches, logs, raw customer IDs, or user-level results. Keep generated files in the
136: ignored `outputs/` directory; do not commit prompts or user-level outputs.
137: 
138: Default invalid policy is `error`; explicit `--on-invalid fallback` keeps the
139: original candidate order for an invalid ranker response and original source text
140: for an invalid encoder paraphrase. These are fallback-inclusive results, **not bare
141: LLM performance**. Report invalid/fallback and valid-only coverage separately.
142: 
143: A timed-out encoder retains prompts and cache but has no completed metrics.
144: A later explicitly authorized run with the **same directory, model and settings**
145: can reuse compatible cache entries; no automatic retry occurs. Completed encoder
146: result directories are rejected: choose a fresh directory for a new benchmark.
147: Preserve failure evidence rather than overwriting previous logs.
148: 
149: ## Completed 100-user HW2 implementation
150: 
151: [HW2 results](HW2_RESULTS.md) records the existing completed teaching runs, their
152: seven-method four-decimal aggregate table, cache-aware timing caveat, and
153: limitations. The cohort retains 11 nonempty-truth and 89 empty-truth users.
154: Ranker results include 22/100 invalid-response fallbacks. This is a ready HW2
155: implementation, **not evidence of strong LLM superiority**; honest negative results
156: are valid. No new inference was performed to package this distribution.

(End of file - total 156 lines)
</content>

# FAR-Trans: Encoder and Ranker baselines

This package provides two runnable open-weight LLM methods, **adaptations rather
than full paper reproductions**, with the [starter](../far-trans/README.md)'s four
baselines and evaluation unchanged. These are optional starting points: use the
approach relevant to your research question, not necessarily both. Identify your
own change and contribution; improvement over the baselines is not required.

- **Encoder:** paraphrase each asset's supplied attributes, combine original and
  generated text as separate TF-IDF views, then match assets to a user's past Buy
  history. Compare `llmrec_encoder` with `original_text_cbf`. Inspired by LLM-Rec's
  basic `p_para` prompt; this uses TF-IDF instead of its text encoder/trained MLP.
- **Ranker:** show the LLM past Buy counts, dated recent purchases, the explicit
  most recent Buy, and fixed CBF candidates; ask it to return ten original ISINs.
  Compare `llmrank` with `candidate_order_first10` on identical candidates.
  This adapts LLMRank's sequential/recency prompting, without ICL, bootstrapping,
  or multi-permutation aggregation.

This README is the primary GitHub guide. Continue with [From HW1 to HW2](HW1_TO_HW2.md)
for questions, exact prompts, input/output formats, and paper references, and
[HW2 results](HW2_RESULTS.md) for the seven-method aggregate comparison.
The optional [HTML handout](BASELINE_GUIDE.html) must be downloaded and opened
locally; GitHub displays its source, not a rendered page. No GitHub Pages hosting
is assumed. Its Markdown companion links are plain text files when opened locally;
read them on GitHub or with a Markdown viewer.

## Dependencies and offline behavior

Use Python 3.12 or a compatible Python 3 environment. Pure-function tests, imports,
CLI help and `--prepare-only` use the standard library; inference additionally needs
**torch and transformers** installed in your own environment. The optional
[requirements.txt](requirements.txt) preserves the measured pins. For example, in
a user-managed uv project use `uv add 'torch==2.11.0' 'transformers==4.57.6'`;
choose the appropriate torch build for your hardware. The measured CUDA wheel
reports `2.11.0+cu128`. Public package/index and CPU/platform wheel availability
must be checked in your own environment; no installation or availability test was
performed during packaging.

The measured local pilot used torch **2.11.0+cu128**, transformers **4.57.6**, and an
NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti **Laptop GPU**, CUDA bfloat16. CUDA is not required by the
API; CPU uses float32 and may be much slower. The pilot required at least 5 GiB free
CUDA memory before starting; that is a local safety gate, **not a promise that every
model/workload fits in 5 GiB**. Do not use a CPU fallback for a time-bounded GPU pilot.

A cached model ID or local snapshot path is accepted. Loading defaults to
`local_files_only=True`, `trust_remote_code=False`; no teacher API or API credentials
are used. **The commands below assume the pinned model is already cached. On first
load in a fresh environment, explicitly add `--allow-download` to authorize the
model download**, or provide a previously downloaded snapshot with `--model`.
Keep `--revision 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e` when using the
`Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B` model ID. Subsequent cached runs omit `--allow-download` and stay
offline. Greedy generation disables thinking through the tokenizer chat template;
context budget is fixed at 8192 tokens; encoder/ranker generation budgets are
160/512 tokens. No context/decoding tuning is performed here.

## Quickstart

From the repository root, change into `project/far-trans-llm`. Replace the data path
with the directory **containing** `transactions.csv`, `asset_information.csv`,
`customer_information.csv`, and `close_prices.csv`.

```bash
cd project/far-trans-llm
python ranker.py --help
python encoder.py --help
python -m unittest discover -s . -p 'test_*.py' -v

# Cached-model inference; add --allow-download explicitly for a first download.
python ranker.py \
  --data-dir /path/to/FAR-Trans \
  --output-dir outputs/my_ranker \
  --max-users 100 --candidate-count 50 \
  --model Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B \
  --revision 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e \
  --device auto --on-invalid fallback

python encoder.py \
  --data-dir /path/to/FAR-Trans \
  --output-dir outputs/my_encoder \
  --max-users 100 --candidate-count 50 \
  --model Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B \
  --revision 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e \
  --device auto --on-invalid fallback
```

The default starter is the sibling `../far-trans`, resolved relative to the script,
not the shell's working directory; no `--starter-dir` is needed. An explicit
`--starter-dir ../far-trans` also works when running from this directory.

For prompt-only inspection, add `--prepare-only` to either command; no model is
loaded or downloaded, and no measured result is produced. For a three-user check,
use `--max-users 3` and a fresh output directory. For a bounded CUDA pilot use
`--device cuda` and GNU `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=2s 120s` (ranker) or
`300s` (encoder) before `python`. Timeout exit 124 is an incomplete experiment,
not a successful result; these pilot time limits do not guarantee a complete
100-user run.

## Data and evaluation protocol

Defaults: cutoff **2021-06-01 exclusive**, 30-day future Buy horizon, deterministic
warm-user selection using the starter's SHA256 seed 42 ordering, repeat purchases
allowed, and 50 CBF candidates. Selection never filters by future truth. Eligible
assets need pre-cutoff metadata and a positive historical close price. The starter
excludes exact duplicate transaction rows and reconstructed initial-position rows.
Same-day event ties use ISIN ordering, not invented intraday chronology. Encoder
candidate count does **not** reduce its full eligible corpus.

Retain and report **Popularity, CBF, Latest buy, and Latest buy or sell** for every
completed run. The starter computes binary nDCG@10, including empty-truth users as
zero in the all-user macro mean; its nonempty-truth mean is reported separately.
Do not change users per method, remove assets to finish generation, or evaluate
partially generated text as a completed encoder benchmark.

Only as-of source metadata/history/profile information enters prompts; truth is
kept separate. Missing values stay unknown. No future news or external lookup is
supplied, but real public asset names may activate a model's pretrained knowledge.
Generated text is **not automatically factually validated**, and these experiments
are not investment advice.

## Outputs, failures and resumption

Completed runs write `predictions.csv`, `metrics.json`, `per_user.json`, and
`run_manifest.json`, preserving all cohort users. `generations.jsonl` records each
request's complete prompt/settings, raw text, tokens and generation time.
`generation_cache/*.json` persists each completed unique request immediately;
identical asset descriptions can share a cache entry, so cache-file count need not
equal completed-asset count. Cache keys bind prompt, model/revision and settings.
Ranker responses also record parse repairs, invalid outputs and fallback decisions.
`ranker_responses.jsonl` is append-only event history: repeated users on resume
are expected, not corruption. On completion, `final_responses.jsonl` contains one
record per current cohort user in manifest order. Runtime `response_log` points
to this canonical file and `history_log` points to the untouched event history.

The distribution contains source/tests/documentation only, not models, data,
caches, logs, raw customer IDs, or user-level results. Keep generated files in the
ignored `outputs/` directory; do not commit prompts or user-level outputs.

Default invalid policy is `error`; explicit `--on-invalid fallback` keeps the
original candidate order for an invalid ranker response and original source text
for an invalid encoder paraphrase. These are fallback-inclusive results, **not bare
LLM performance**. Report invalid/fallback and valid-only coverage separately.

A timed-out encoder retains prompts and cache but has no completed metrics.
A later explicitly authorized run with the **same directory, model and settings**
can reuse compatible cache entries; no automatic retry occurs. Completed encoder
result directories are rejected: choose a fresh directory for a new benchmark.
Preserve failure evidence rather than overwriting previous logs.

## Completed 100-user HW2 implementation

[HW2 results](HW2_RESULTS.md) records the existing completed teaching runs, their
seven-method four-decimal aggregate table, cache-aware timing caveat, and
limitations. The cohort retains 11 nonempty-truth and 89 empty-truth users.
Ranker results include 22/100 invalid-response fallbacks. This is a ready HW2
implementation, **not evidence of strong LLM superiority**; honest negative results
are valid. No new inference was performed to package this distribution.

def run(args, bundle, generator=None):
    starter, assets, history, _truth, contexts, _baseline, events, _pop, manifest = bundle
    if args.history_events < 1:
        raise ValueError('history-events must be positive')
    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    prompts = []
    for uid in manifest['users']:
        prompts.append((uid, build_prompt(contexts[uid], assets, history.get(uid, {}),
                                         events.get(uid, ()), args.history_events,
                                         args.shuffle_seed)))
    if args.prepare_only:
        # Distinct staging artifact: no metrics, predictions, or model calls.
        path = args.output_dir / 'ranker_prompts.jsonl'
        with path.open('w', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
            for uid, prompt in prompts:
                stream.write(json.dumps({'user_id': uid, 'prompt': prompt,
                                         'stage': 'prepare_only_no_inference'}, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
        return {'stage': 'prepare_only_no_inference', 'users': len(prompts)}
    if generator is None:
        from runtime import LocalGenerator, LoggedGenerator
        generator = LoggedGenerator(LocalGenerator(args.model, args.revision, args.device,
                                                   args.allow_download), args.output_dir)
    predictions, failures = {}, []
    current_records = []
    invalid_count = repair_count = 0
    for uid, prompt in prompts:
        ids = candidate_ids(contexts[uid])
        record = {'user_id': uid, 'raw_response': None, 'parse_repaired': False,
                  'fallback': False, 'error': None}
        try:
            response = generator.generate(prompt, max_new_tokens=512)
            record['raw_response'] = response['text']
            ranking, repaired = parse_ranking(response['text'], set(ids))
            record['parse_repaired'] = repaired
            repair_count += int(repaired)
            starter.validate_ranking(ranking, ids)
        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, RuntimeError) as exc:
            invalid_count += 1
            record['error'] = f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'
            record['fallback'] = args.on_invalid == 'fallback'
            failures.append(dict(record))
            if args.on_invalid == 'error':
                record.update(raw_invalid_count=invalid_count, parse_repair_count=repair_count)
                append_record(args.output_dir / 'ranker_responses.jsonl', record)
                raise ValueError(f'{uid}: invalid ranker output: {exc}') from exc
            ranking = ids[:10]
        record.update(raw_invalid_count=invalid_count, parse_repair_count=repair_count)
        append_record(args.output_dir / 'ranker_responses.jsonl', record)
        current_records.append(record)
        predictions[uid] = {'llmrank': ranking, 'candidate_order_first10': ids[:10]}
    # The history remains append-only across resumed passes. Publish only this
    # completed pass, already in manifest order, as the canonical response artifact.
    with (args.output_dir / 'final_responses.jsonl').open('w', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        for record in current_records:
            stream.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
    metadata = dict(generator.metadata, raw_invalid_count=invalid_count,
                    parse_repair_count=repair_count, shuffle_seed=args.shuffle_seed,
                    history_events=args.history_events, adaptation='sequential_recency_only',
                    response_log='final_responses.jsonl',
                    history_log='ranker_responses.jsonl')
    data_adapter.save_results(args, bundle, predictions, failures, 'llmrank', metadata)
    return metadata


def main(argv=None):
    parser = data_adapter.arguments('LLMRank sequential/recency fixed-candidate adaptation')
    parser.add_argument('--shuffle-seed', type=int, help='Shuffle presentation only, not candidate membership')
    parser.add_argument('--history-events', type=int, default=15)
    parser.add_argument('--prepare-only', action='store_true', help='Write prompts only; no inference or measured results')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    run(args, data_adapter.load(args))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Share the teaching starter's data policy without passing truth to models."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path


def arguments(description):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=description)
    parser.add_argument('--starter-dir', type=Path,
                        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / 'far-trans')
    parser.add_argument('--data-dir', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output-dir', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--cutoff', default='2021-06-01')
    parser.add_argument('--horizon-days', type=int, default=30)
    parser.add_argument('--max-users', type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument('--candidate-count', type=int, default=50)
    parser.add_argument('--model', required=True, help='Local model directory or cached HF model ID')
    parser.add_argument('--revision', help='Pinned Hugging Face revision; use with a model ID')
    parser.add_argument('--device', choices=['auto', 'cpu', 'cuda'], default='auto')
    parser.add_argument('--allow-download', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--on-invalid', choices=['error', 'fallback'], default='error')
    return parser


def load(args):
    if args.max_users < 1 or args.horizon_days < 1 or args.candidate_count < 10:
        raise ValueError('Require max-users > 0, horizon-days > 0 and candidate-count >= 10')
    path = args.starter_dir / 'starter.py'
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('provided_far_trans_starter', path)
    starter = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(starter)
    assets, profiles, history, truth, end, excluded = starter.load_data(
        args.data_dir, args.cutoff, args.horizon_days)
    users = starter.select_users(profiles, history, 'warm', args.max_users, None)
    features = {isin: starter.tokens(asset) for isin, asset in assets.items()}
    pop = starter.popularity_scores(history, assets)
    contexts, baseline = starter.contexts_for(users, assets, profiles, history, features,
                                             pop, args.cutoff, args.candidate_count, False)
    events = starter.scan_recent_events(args.data_dir, args.cutoff, assets)
    recent = starter.recency_rankings(contexts, pop, events, k=10)
    for uid in users:
        baseline[uid].update(recent[uid])
    manifest = {
        'teaching_settings_not_official_test': True,
        'cutoff': args.cutoff, 'end_exclusive': end, 'users': users,
        'repeat_allowed': True, 'candidate_count': args.candidate_count,
        'empty_truth_policy': 'zero in all-user mean; nonempty mean also reported',
        'excluded_rows': excluded,
        'data_sha256': {name: hashlib.sha256((args.data_dir / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                        for name in ('transactions.csv', 'asset_information.csv',
                                     'customer_information.csv', 'close_prices.csv')},
    }
    return starter, assets, history, truth, contexts, baseline, events, pop, manifest


def save_results(args, bundle, predictions, failures, method, runtime_metadata):
    import csv
    starter, assets, history, truth, contexts, baseline, events, pop, manifest = bundle
    records = []
    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (args.output_dir / 'predictions.csv').open('w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        writer = csv.writer(stream)
        writer.writerow(['method', 'user_id', 'rank', 'ISIN'])
        for uid in manifest['users']:
            combined = dict(baseline[uid])
            combined.update(predictions[uid])
            for name, ranking in combined.items():
                starter.validate_ranking(ranking, contexts[uid]['eligible_asset_ids'])
                relevant = truth.get(uid, set()) & set(contexts[uid]['eligible_asset_ids'])
                records.append({'user_id': uid, 'method': name,
                                'relevant_count': len(relevant),
                                'ndcg_at_10': starter.ndcg10(ranking, relevant)})
                writer.writerows((name, uid, rank, isin)
                                 for rank, isin in enumerate(ranking, 1))
    names = sorted({r['method'] for r in records})
    metrics = {name: starter.aggregate([r for r in records if r['method'] == name])
               for name in names}
    for name, data in (('metrics.json', metrics), ('per_user.json', records),
                       ('run_manifest.json', dict(manifest, method=method,
                                                 runtime=runtime_metadata,
                                                 failures=failures))):
        (args.output_dir / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n',
                                            encoding='utf-8')
    for name, metric in metrics.items():
        value = metric['ndcg_at_10']
        print(f'{name}: nDCG@10={value:.4f}' if value is not None else f'{name}: no users')

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Convert, independently score, and analyse the frozen provided-ranker run."""
+import csv
+from datetime import date, datetime
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+from starter import load_data, ndcg10, scan_recent_events
+from hw3_paired_analysis import apply_fallback, bootstrap, check, jsonl, sha, wtl
+from hw3_repeat_first import repeat_first
+
+BASE = ROOT / 'outputs/baseline_200'
+FINAL = ROOT / 'outputs/final_200'
+PROVIDED = ROOT / 'outputs/provided_llm_200'
+EXPECTED = 'd46b45deaf2c2f955c52fa020082971947d5ac8e27073a90d1c5384f648af697'
+RANKER_HASH = '7c6b81794f7da10aab053074d86525b63d64aef10a08ff54ff5b6b8fa5de9f24'
+
+
+def mean(values):
+    return sum(values) / len(values)
+
+
+def saved_rankings(path):
+    groups = {}
+    with path.open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
+        for row in csv.DictReader(stream):
+            groups.setdefault(row['method'], {}).setdefault(row['user_id'], []).append(
+                (int(row['rank']), row['ISIN']))
+    result = {}
+    for method, by_user in groups.items():
+        result[method] = {}
+        for uid, rows in by_user.items():
+            rows.sort()
+            check([rank for rank, _ in rows] == list(range(1, 11)), 'saved ranking length mismatch')
+            result[method][uid] = [asset for _, asset in rows]
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    new_files = [FINAL / name for name in
+                 ('P_responses.jsonl', 'MANIFEST_P.json', 'provided_analysis.json', 'score_P.txt')]
+    evaluation = FINAL / 'evaluation_P'
+    check(not evaluation.exists() and all(not path.exists() for path in new_files),
+          'new provided scoring output already exists; refusing to overwrite')
+    existing = [path for folder in ('outputs', 'cohorts', 'scripts')
+                for path in (ROOT / folder).rglob('*') if path.is_file()]
+    existing += [path for path in ROOT.iterdir() if path.is_file() and
+                 path.name.startswith(('HW3_', 'run_hw3_'))]
+    frozen = {path: sha(path) for path in existing}
+    protocol = json.loads((BASE / 'protocol.json').read_text())
+    contexts = jsonl(BASE / 'contexts.jsonl')
+    users = [ctx['user_id'] for ctx in contexts]
+    check(len(users) == len(set(users)) == 200 and users == protocol['users']
+          and protocol['protocol_hash'] == EXPECTED, 'baseline cohort or protocol mismatch')
+    provenance = json.loads((PROVIDED / 'run_provenance.json').read_text())
+    check(provenance['exit_code'] == 0 and bool(provenance.get('end_time')), 'provided run incomplete')
+    ranker_path = Path(provenance['script'])
+    check(provenance['script_sha256'] == sha(ranker_path) == RANKER_HASH, 'ranker hash mismatch')
+    check(provenance['starter_sha256'] == sha(ROOT / 'starter.py'), 'starter hash mismatch')
+    for filename, expected in provenance['support_sources_sha256'].items():
+        check(sha(ranker_path.parent / filename) == expected, 'provided support-source hash mismatch')
+    verified = provenance['input_verification']
+    check(verified['same_users_in_order'] and verified['same_candidate_sets'], 'prepared input mismatch')
+    for filename, expected in verified['sha256'].items():
+        check(sha(ROOT / filename) == expected, 'verified input source changed')
+    source = PROVIDED / 'final_responses.jsonl'
+    records = jsonl(source)
+    indexed = {row['user_id']: row for row in records}
+    coverage = len(records) == len(indexed) == 200 and set(indexed) == set(users)
+    print(f'Canonical responses: rows={len(records)} unique_users={len(indexed)} same_users={coverage}', flush=True)
+    check(coverage, 'canonical response coverage mismatch')
+    manifest = json.loads((PROVIDED / 'run_manifest.json').read_text())
+    check(manifest['users'] == users, 'provided manifest user order mismatch')
+    check(manifest['cutoff'] == protocol['cutoff'] and manifest['end_exclusive'] == protocol['end_exclusive']
+          and manifest['candidate_count'] == protocol['candidate_count'] and manifest['repeat_allowed']
+          and manifest['data_sha256'] == protocol['source_sha256'], 'provided manifest data policy mismatch')
+    check(manifest['runtime']['shuffle_seed'] is None and manifest['runtime']['history_events'] == 15,
+          'provided run differs from verified prepare-only settings')
+    own_predictions = saved_rankings(PROVIDED / 'predictions.csv')
+    base_predictions = saved_rankings(BASE / 'predictions.csv')
+    cbf = base_predictions['cbf']

+        'reason': 'Provided canonical responses contain no protocol hash or ranked_ids; '

+        'schema_conversion': 'Valid raw responses parsed with unchanged provided ranker.parse_ranking; '

+        'starter_sha256': provenance['starter_sha256'],
+        'input_verification': verified, 'output_sha256': sha(p_file),
+        'scoring_rule': 'starter --on-invalid fallback',
+    }
+    with (FINAL / 'MANIFEST_P.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
+        stream.write(json.dumps(p_manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
+    days = (date.fromisoformat(protocol['end_exclusive']) - date.fromisoformat(protocol['cutoff'])).days

+    data = ROOT.parent / 'Session 1/FAR-Trans'

+#!/usr/bin/env python3

+from datetime import date, datetime

+import json
+import math

+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

+
+def mean(values):
+    return sum(values) / len(values)
+
+
+def saved_rankings(path):
+    groups = {}
+    with path.open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
+        for row in csv.DictReader(stream):
+            groups.setdefault(row['method'], {}).setdefault(row['user_id'], []).append(
+                (int(row['rank']), row['ISIN']))
+    result = {}
+    for method, by_user in groups.items():
+        result[method] = {}
+        for uid, rows in by_user.items():
+            rows.sort()
+            check([rank for rank, _ in rows] == list(range(1, 11)), 'saved ranking length mismatch')
+            result[method][uid] = [asset for _, asset in rows]
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    new_files = [FINAL / name for name in

+    evaluation = FINAL / 'evaluation_P'
+    check(not evaluation.exists() and all(not path.exists() for path in new_files),
+          'new provided scoring output already exists; refusing to overwrite')
+    existing = [path for folder in ('outputs', 'cohorts', 'scripts')
+                for path in (ROOT / folder).rglob('*') if path.is_file()]
+    existing += [path for path in ROOT.iterdir() if path.is_file() and
+                 path.name.startswith(('HW3_', 'run_hw3_'))]
+    frozen = {path: sha(path) for path in existing}
+    protocol = json.loads((BASE / 'protocol.json').read_text())
+    contexts = jsonl(BASE / 'contexts.jsonl')

+    check(len(users) == len(set(users)) == 200 and users == protocol['users']
+          and protocol['protocol_hash'] == EXPECTED, 'baseline cohort or protocol mismatch')
+    provenance = json.loads((PROVIDED / 'run_provenance.json').read_text())
+    check(provenance['exit_code'] == 0 and bool(provenance.get('end_time')), 'provided run incomplete')
+    ranker_path = Path(provenance['script'])
+    check(provenance['script_sha256'] == sha(ranker_path) == RANKER_HASH, 'ranker hash mismatch')
+    check(provenance['starter_sha256'] == sha(ROOT / 'starter.py'), 'starter hash mismatch')
+    for filename, expected in provenance['support_sources_sha256'].items():
+        check(sha(ranker_path.parent / filename) == expected, 'provided support-source hash mismatch')
+    verified = provenance['input_verification']
+    check(verified['same_users_in_order'] and verified['same_candidate_sets'], 'prepared input mismatch')
+    for filename, expected in verified['sha256'].items():
+        check(sha(ROOT / filename) == expected, 'verified input source changed')
+    source = PROVIDED / 'final_responses.jsonl'

+    indexed = {row['user_id']: row for row in records}

+data = '../Session 1/FAR-Trans'

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Planned held-out block scoring with official fallback and frozen C+R V2."""
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+from starter import scan_recent_events
+from hw3_paired_analysis import apply_fallback, check, jsonl, sha
+from hw3_repeat_first import repeat_first
+from hw3_sparse_analysis import read_rankings
+
+BASE = ROOT / 'outputs/block_201_300'
+DEST = ROOT / 'outputs/block_scores'
+EXPECTED = 'e126569ce481716d7039c495e2c7fedbbbe552e308b819b84c4be87b0eb5fe8d'
+REGISTRATIONS = {
+    'HW3_BLOCK_201_300.md': 'a99403c56472dde79a5767c7c85a34826ecbc34e8f9c0d8c1187df91a7d18bb6',
+    'HW3_PLAN_C_IMPROVEMENT.md': 'fa99792f07dfdb8b48a63235ba8652a1aeca8a6080ac0cea0343445e69ad1402',
+    'HW3_PLAN_C_IMPROVEMENT_CLARIFICATION.md': '68311cda32e608c805bc0cc1ca3f9b0b50b3c232bb2e1da5d58bf2c7a7fe96ab',
+    'scripts/hw3_repeat_first.py': 'e1401a71475dcd50c0db56f01284f0086e76a6d12f1e0d9846c1a088a067c437',
+}
+
+
+def existing_hashes():
+    paths = [p for folder in ('outputs', 'cohorts', 'scripts') for p in (ROOT / folder).rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
+    paths += [p for p in ROOT.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name.startswith(('HW3_', 'run_hw3_'))]
+    return {p: sha(p) for p in paths}
+
+
+def main():
+    check(not DEST.exists(), 'block_scores exists; refusing to overwrite')
+    frozen = existing_hashes()
+    for name, expected in REGISTRATIONS.items():
+        check(sha(ROOT / name) == expected, 'registration or repeat-first hash mismatch')
+    protocol = json.loads((BASE / 'protocol.json').read_text())
+    contexts = jsonl(BASE / 'contexts.jsonl')
+    users = [ctx['user_id'] for ctx in contexts]
+    check(len(users) == len(set(users)) == 100 and users == protocol['users'] ==
+          (ROOT / 'cohorts/block_201_300_users.txt').read_text().splitlines(), 'block cohort mismatch')
+    check(protocol['protocol_hash'] == EXPECTED and protocol['cutoff'] == '2021-06-01'
+          and protocol['end_exclusive'] == '2021-07-01' and protocol['candidate_count'] == 50
+          and protocol['cohort_selection'] == 'warm' and not protocol['exclude_seen'], 'block protocol mismatch')
+    baseline = json.loads((BASE / 'metrics.json').read_text())
+    baseline_rankings = read_rankings(BASE / 'predictions.csv')
+    cbf = baseline_rankings['cbf']
+    rankings, invalid, times = {}, {}, {}
+    for arm in ('A', 'C'):
+        source = ROOT / 'outputs' / f'block_{arm}'
+        rankings[arm], invalid[arm] = apply_fallback(jsonl(source / 'responses.jsonl'), contexts, cbf, EXPECTED)
+        meta = json.loads((source / 'run_meta.json').read_text())
+        provenance = json.loads((source / 'run_provenance.json').read_text())
+        check(provenance['exit_code'] == 0 and bool(provenance.get('end_time')) and meta['users'] == 100,
+              'block inference incomplete')
+        check(meta['invalid_outputs'] == len(invalid[arm]), 'recorded invalid count mismatch')
+        times[arm] = meta['wall_seconds_whole_arm'] / 100
+    DEST.mkdir()
+    summary = {'label': 'held-out development block; reported separately, not pooled',
+               'users': 100, 'starter_positions': [201, 300], 'protocol_hash': EXPECTED,
+               'nonempty_truth_users': baseline['methods']['cbf']['nonempty_truth_users'],
+               'C_plus_R_variant': 'V2, unchanged, selected on main 200 only',
+               'scoring_rule': 'starter --on-invalid fallback', 'methods': {},
+               'registration_sha256': REGISTRATIONS, 'score_script_sha256': sha(Path(__file__))}
+    for name, key in (('Latest buy or sell', 'latest_buy_or_sell'), ('Latest buy', 'latest_buy'),
+                       ('Popularity', 'popularity'), ('CBF', 'cbf')):
+        summary['methods'][name] = dict(baseline['methods'][key], invalid_rows=0, fallbacks=0,
+                                        seconds_per_user=None, rule_overhead_unmeasured=False)
+
+    def score(arm, response, output_name, expected_invalid):
+        output = DEST / output_name
+        check(not output.exists(), 'block score directory exists; refusing to overwrite')
+        command = [sys.executable, str(ROOT / 'starter.py'), 'run', '--stage', 'ranker',
+                   '--responses', str(response), '--on-invalid', 'fallback',
+                   '--users-file', 'cohorts/block_201_300_users.txt', '--cutoff', '2021-06-01',
+                   '--horizon-days', '30', '--cohort', 'warm', '--data-dir', '../Session 1/FAR-Trans',
+                   '--output-dir', str(output)]
+        completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)
+        check(completed.returncode == 0, f'{arm} scoring exit code {completed.returncode}')
+        metrics = json.loads((output / 'metrics.json').read_text())
+        check(metrics['protocol_hash'] == EXPECTED and (output / 'contexts.jsonl').read_bytes() ==
+              (BASE / 'contexts.jsonl').read_bytes(), 'regenerated block protocol or contexts differ')
+        check(all(metrics['methods'][key] == values for key, values in baseline['methods'].items()),
+              'regenerated baseline metrics differ')
+        check(len(metrics['custom_failures']) == expected_invalid, 'fallback count mismatch')
+        check(read_rankings(output / 'predictions.csv')['custom'] == rankings[arm], 'scored rankings differ')
+        summary['methods'][arm] = dict(metrics['methods']['custom'], invalid_rows=expected_invalid,
+                                       fallbacks=expected_invalid, seconds_per_user=times.get(arm, times['C']),
+                                       rule_overhead_unmeasured=arm == 'C+R')
+
+    for arm in ('A', 'C'):
+        score(arm, ROOT / 'outputs' / f'block_{arm}/responses.jsonl', arm, len(invalid[arm]))
+    events = scan_recent_events(ROOT.parent / 'Session 1/FAR-Trans', protocol['cutoff'], set(protocol['eligible_assets']))
+    latest = {}
+    for uid in users:
+        last = {}
+        for timestamp, isin, kind in events.get(uid, []):
+            check(timestamp < protocol['cutoff'], 'future event in repeat-first history')
+            if kind == 'Buy':
+                last[isin] = max(last.get(isin, timestamp), timestamp)
+        latest[uid] = last
+    rankings['C+R'] = {ctx['user_id']: repeat_first(ctx, rankings['C'][ctx['user_id']],
+                                                  latest[ctx['user_id']], 'V2') for ctx in contexts}
+    derived = DEST / 'C_plus_R_responses.jsonl'
+    with derived.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
+        for uid in users:
+            stream.write(json.dumps({'user_id': uid, 'stage': 'ranker', 'protocol_hash': EXPECTED,
+                                     'ranked_ids': rankings['C+R'][uid]}) + '\n')
+    score('C+R', derived, 'C_plus_R', 0)
+    check(all(sha(path) == expected for path, expected in frozen.items()), 'existing protected file changed')
+    sources = [BASE / 'protocol.json', BASE / 'contexts.jsonl', BASE / 'metrics.json',
+               ROOT / 'outputs/block_A/responses.jsonl', ROOT / 'outputs/block_C/responses.jsonl']
+    summary['source_sha256'] = {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(path) for path in sources}
+    summary['C_plus_R_responses_sha256'] = sha(derived)
+    summary['protected_existing_files_checked_unchanged'] = len(frozen)
+    with (DEST / 'scoring_summary.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
+        stream.write(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
+    print('| Held-out method | nDCG@10 all 100 | nDCG@10 nonempty | Nonempty users | Fallbacks | Seconds/user |')
+    print('| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |')
+    for name, row in summary['methods'].items():
+        seconds = '—' if row['seconds_per_user'] is None else f'{row["seconds_per_user"]:.4f}'
+        if row['rule_overhead_unmeasured']:
+            seconds += ' + unmeasured rule'
+        print(f'| {name} | {row["ndcg_at_10"]:.4f} | {row["ndcg_at_10_nonempty"]:.4f} | '
+              f'{row["nonempty_truth_users"]} | {row["fallbacks"]} | {seconds} |')
+    print(f'scripts/hw3_block_score.py SHA-256: {sha(Path(__file__))}')
+    for path in sorted(DEST.rglob('*.json')):
+        print(f'{path.relative_to(ROOT)} SHA-256: {sha(path)}')
+    print(f'{derived.relative_to(ROOT)} SHA-256: {sha(derived)}')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
*** End Patch

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""One pre-registered all-eligible repeat-first variant; no model calls or selection."""
+from datetime import date
+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+from starter import load_data, ndcg10, scan_recent_events
+from hw3_paired_analysis import apply_fallback, bootstrap, check, jsonl, sha, wtl
+from hw3_repeat_first import repeat_first
+from hw3_sparse_analysis import read_rankings
+
+PLAN = ROOT / 'HW3_PLAN_C_ALL.md'
+DEST = ROOT / 'outputs/all_cand_scores'
+BASELINES = {'Latest buy or sell': 'latest_buy_or_sell', 'Latest buy': 'latest_buy',
+             'Popularity': 'popularity', 'CBF': 'cbf'}
+SETS = {
+    'main_200': {'old': 'outputs/baseline_200', 'new': 'outputs/all_cand_main_200', 'n': 200,
+                 'A': 'outputs/final_200/A_responses.jsonl', 'C': 'outputs/arm_C2_200/responses.jsonl',
+                 'users_file': None, 'previous': 'outputs/final_200/repeat_first.json'},
+    'sparse_120': {'old': 'outputs/sparse_baseline_120', 'new': 'outputs/all_cand_sparse_120', 'n': 120,
+                    'A': 'outputs/sparse_A/responses.jsonl', 'C': 'outputs/sparse_C/responses.jsonl',
+                    'users_file': 'cohorts/sparse_window_users.txt',
+                    'previous': 'outputs/sparse_scores/repeat_first.json'},
+    'block_100': {'old': 'outputs/block_201_300', 'new': 'outputs/all_cand_block_100', 'n': 100,
+                   'A': 'outputs/block_A/responses.jsonl', 'C': 'outputs/block_C/responses.jsonl',
+                   'users_file': 'cohorts/block_201_300_users.txt',
+                   'previous': 'outputs/block_scores/scoring_summary.json'},
+}
+METHOD_KEYS = {'A': 'A', 'C': 'C', 'C+R': 'C_R_50', 'A+R-all': 'A_R_all', 'C+R-all': 'C_R_all'}
+
+
+def mean(values):
+    return sum(values) / len(values)
+
+
+def starter_run(common, output, responses=None):
+    check(not output.exists(), 'all-candidate scoring directory exists; refusing to overwrite')
+    command = [sys.executable, str(ROOT / 'starter.py'), 'run', *common, '--output-dir', str(output)]
+    if responses is not None:
+        command += ['--stage', 'ranker', '--responses', str(responses), '--on-invalid', 'fallback']
+    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)
+    check(result.returncode == 0, f'starter scoring exit code {result.returncode}')
+    return json.loads((output / 'protocol.json').read_text()), json.loads((output / 'metrics.json').read_text())
+
+
+def main():
+    check(sha(PLAN) == 'f3aace44fa9c19d9ef39b15781a5b0063d1939bcfac9ebaf5b667c0290229caf',
+          'all-candidate pre-registration hash mismatch')
+    check(sha(ROOT / 'scripts/hw3_repeat_first.py') ==
+          'e1401a71475dcd50c0db56f01284f0086e76a6d12f1e0d9846c1a088a067c437', 'repeat-first source hash mismatch')
+    check(not DEST.exists() and all(not (ROOT / spec['new']).exists() for spec in SETS.values()),
+          'an all-candidate output directory exists; refusing to overwrite')
+    protected = [p for folder in ('outputs', 'cohorts', 'scripts') for p in (ROOT / folder).rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
+    protected += [p for p in ROOT.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name.startswith(('HW3_', 'run_hw3_'))]
+    frozen = {p: sha(p) for p in protected}
+    # All sets and the single V2 variant are fixed before any new score inspection.

+        old = ROOT / spec['old']

+        old_contexts = jsonl(old / 'contexts.jsonl')
+        count = len(protocol['eligible_assets'])
+        horizon = (date.fromisoformat(protocol['end_exclusive']) - date.fromisoformat(protocol['cutoff'])).days
+        common = ['--data-dir', '../Session 1/FAR-Trans', '--cutoff', protocol['cutoff'],
+                  '--horizon-days', str(horizon), '--cohort', protocol['cohort_selection'],
+                  '--candidate-count', str(count)]
+        check(not protocol['exclude_seen'], 'unexpected exclude-seen policy')

+
+def buy_or_sell_repeat_first(context, a_order, events, cutoff):

+    counts = {asset['id']: asset['buy_count'] for asset in context['history']}

+    latest = {}

+    check(all(isin in latest for isin in repeats), 'previously bought asset missing an eligible event date')

+        for ctx, old in zip(contexts, prior_contexts))
+    old_metrics = json.loads((OLD / 'metrics.json').read_text())
+    unchanged = new_metrics['methods'] == old_metrics['methods']
+    all_assets = new_protocol['candidate_count'] == count and all(
+        len(ctx['candidate_assets']) == count and {a['id'] for a in ctx['candidate_assets']} ==
+        set(protocol['eligible_assets']) for ctx in contexts)
+    print(f'Same users/order: {same_users}; first50 same order: {same_first50}; baselines identical: {unchanged}', flush=True)
+    print(f'All eligible candidates: {all_assets}; eligible_assets={count}; protocol_hash={new_protocol["protocol_hash"]}', flush=True)
+    check(same_users and same_first50 and unchanged and all_assets, 'all-eligible benchmark input mismatch')
+    baseline_rankings = read_rankings(NEW / 'predictions.csv')
+    rankings = {name: baseline_rankings[key] for name, key in LABELS.items()}
+    source_rows = jsonl(SOURCE / 'responses.jsonl')
+    rankings['A'], invalid = apply_fallback(source_rows, prior_contexts, rankings['CBF'], protocol['protocol_hash'])
+    check(len(invalid) == meta['invalid_outputs'], 'A invalid count mismatch')
+    data = ROOT.parent / 'Session 1/FAR-Trans'
+    for filename, expected in protocol['source_sha256'].items():
+        check(sha(data / filename) == expected, 'dataset source hash mismatch')
+    assets, _, history, future, end, _ = load_data(data, '2021-06-01', 30)
+    check(end == protocol['end_exclusive'] == '2021-07-01' and sorted(assets) == protocol['eligible_assets'],
+          'truth reconstruction protocol mismatch')
+    events = scan_recent_events(data, '2021-06-01', assets)
+    latest_buy = {}
+    for ctx in contexts:
+        uid = ctx['user_id']
+        check({a['id']: a['buy_count'] for a in ctx['history']} == dict(history.get(uid, {})),
+              'context history differs from starter history')
+        last = {}
+        for timestamp, isin, kind in events.get(uid, []):
+            check(timestamp < '2021-06-01', 'future event in rule inputs')
+            if kind == 'Buy':
+                last[isin] = max(last.get(isin, timestamp), timestamp)
+        latest_buy[uid] = last
+    rankings['B1'] = {ctx['user_id']: repeat_first(ctx, rankings['A'][ctx['user_id']],
+                                                  latest_buy[ctx['user_id']], 'V2') for ctx in contexts}
+    rankings['B2'] = {ctx['user_id']: buy_or_sell_repeat_first(
+        ctx, rankings['A'][ctx['user_id']], events.get(ctx['user_id'], []), '2021-06-01') for ctx in contexts}
+    DEST.mkdir()
+    scored = {}
+    for method in ('A', 'B1', 'B2'):
+        responses = DEST / f'{method}_responses.jsonl'
+        if method == 'A':
+            source_by_user = {row['user_id']: row for row in source_rows}
+            records = [dict(source_by_user[uid], protocol_hash=new_protocol['protocol_hash']) for uid in users]
+        else:
+            records = [{'user_id': uid, 'stage': 'ranker', 'protocol_hash': new_protocol['protocol_hash'],
+                        'ranked_ids': rankings[method][uid]} for uid in users]
+        with responses.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
+            stream.write(''.join(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n' for row in records))
+        output = DEST / method
+        scored_protocol, metrics = starter_run(common, output, responses)
+        check(scored_protocol['protocol_hash'] == new_protocol['protocol_hash'] and
+              (output / 'contexts.jsonl').read_bytes() == (NEW / 'contexts.jsonl').read_bytes(),
+              'method score used different all-eligible inputs')
+        check(all(metrics['methods'][key] == values for key, values in new_metrics['methods'].items()),
+              'method-scoring baselines changed')
+        wanted = len(invalid) if method == 'A' else 0
+        check(len(metrics['custom_failures']) == wanted, 'method fallback count mismatch')
+        check(read_rankings(output / 'predictions.csv')['custom'] == rankings[method], 'scored rankings differ')
+        scored[method] = {'metrics': metrics['methods']['custom'], 'fallbacks': wanted,
+                          'derived_response_sha256': sha(responses)}
+    truth = {ctx['user_id']: future.get(ctx['user_id'], set()) & set(ctx['eligible_asset_ids']) for ctx in contexts}
+    nonempty = [index for index, uid in enumerate(users) if truth[uid]]
+    scores = {name: [ndcg10(by_user[uid], truth[uid]) for uid in users] for name, by_user in rankings.items()}
+    result = {
+        'label': 'benchmark-method selection on fresh block 301–400; not used for HW3 conclusions',
+        'users': 100, 'starter_positions': [301, 400], 'nonempty_truth_users': len(nonempty),
+        'plan_sha256': sha(PLAN), 'original_protocol_hash': protocol['protocol_hash'],
+        'all_eligible_protocol_hash': new_protocol['protocol_hash'], 'eligible_assets': count,
+        'checks': {'same_users_order': same_users, 'first50_same_order': same_first50,
+                   'baselines_identical': unchanged, 'all_eligible': all_assets},
+        'rules': {'B1': 'unchanged repeat_first V2 using pre-cutoff Buy counts',
+                  'B2': 'previously BOUGHT eligible assets only; most recent pre-cutoff Buy-or-Sell date; '
+                        'ties: higher Buy count, then A order, then CBF order; remaining slots in A order'},
+        'source_model_fallbacks': len(invalid), 'methods': {}, 'pairs': {},
+        'statistical_conventions': {'bootstrap': '10000 paired resamples of all 100 users, Python random.Random(0) '
+                                                'reset for each pair; percentile CI with linear interpolation',
+                                    'wins_ties_losses': 'nonempty users only; exact score equality for ties',
+                                    'sign_test': 'exact two-sided binomial p=0.5 over non-tied users',
+                                    'empty_truth_policy': 'zero in primary mean'},
+    }
+    for name in (*LABELS, 'A', 'B1', 'B2'):
+        all_mean = mean(scores[name])
+        nonempty_mean = mean([scores[name][i] for i in nonempty])
+        reference = scored[name]['metrics'] if name in scored else new_metrics['methods'][LABELS[name]]
+        check(math.isclose(all_mean, reference['ndcg_at_10'], abs_tol=1e-15) and
+              math.isclose(nonempty_mean, reference['ndcg_at_10_nonempty'], abs_tol=1e-15),
+              'analysis did not reproduce starter score')
+        result['methods'][name] = {'ndcg_at_10_all': all_mean, 'ndcg_at_10_nonempty': nonempty_mean,
+                                   'nonempty_truth_users': len(nonempty),
+                                   'fallbacks': scored[name]['fallbacks'] if name in scored else 0,
+                                   'seconds_per_user': meta['wall_seconds_whole_arm'] / 100 if name == 'A' else None}
+    for left, right in (('B2', 'B1'), ('B1', 'Latest buy or sell'), ('B2', 'Latest buy or sell'), ('B1', 'A')):
+        differences = [a - b for a, b in zip(scores[left], scores[right])]
+        result['pairs'][f'{left} - {right}'] = {'mean_difference_all_100': mean(differences),
+                                               'bootstrap_95_ci': bootstrap(differences),
+                                               'nonempty_wins_ties_losses': wtl([differences[i] for i in nonempty])}
+    b1, b2 = mean(scores['B1']), mean(scores['B2'])
+    selected = 'B2' if b2 > b1 else 'B1'
+    result['selection'] = {'selected_variant': selected, 'criterion': 'higher all-100 mean nDCG@10; tie → B1',
+                            'B1_ndcg_at_10': b1, 'B2_ndcg_at_10': b2, 'exact_tie': b1 == b2}
+    sources = [PLAN, SOURCE / 'responses.jsonl', SOURCE / 'run_meta.json', SOURCE / 'run_provenance.json',
+               OLD / 'protocol.json', OLD / 'contexts.jsonl', NEW / 'protocol.json', NEW / 'contexts.jsonl',
+               ROOT / 'scripts/hw3_repeat_first.py', ROOT / 'starter.py']
+    result['source_sha256'] = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(p) for p in sources}
+    result['derived_response_sha256'] = {method: item['derived_response_sha256'] for method, item in scored.items()}
+    result['analysis_script_sha256'] = sha(Path(__file__))
+    check(all(sha(p) == expected for p, expected in frozen.items()), 'existing protected file changed')
+    result['protected_existing_files_checked_unchanged'] = len(frozen)
+    with (DEST / 'bench_select.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
+        stream.write(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
+    print('| Benchmark method | nDCG@10 all 100 | nDCG@10 nonempty | Nonempty users | Fallbacks | A seconds/user |')
+    print('| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |')
+    for name, row in result['methods'].items():
+        seconds = '—' if row['seconds_per_user'] is None else f'{row["seconds_per_user"]:.4f}'
+        print(f'| {name} | {row["ndcg_at_10_all"]:.4f} | {row["ndcg_at_10_nonempty"]:.4f} | '
+              f'{row["nonempty_truth_users"]} | {row["fallbacks"]} | {seconds} |')
+    print('| Pair | Mean difference | Bootstrap 95% CI | W/T/L nonempty | Exact sign p |')
+    print('| --- | ---: | --- | --- | ---: |')
+    for name, comparison in result['pairs'].items():
+        ci, counts = comparison['bootstrap_95_ci'], comparison['nonempty_wins_ties_losses']
+        print(f'| {name} | {comparison["mean_difference_all_100"]:.4f} | [{ci[0]:.4f}, {ci[1]:.4f}] | '
+              f'{counts["wins"]}/{counts["ties"]}/{counts["losses"]} | {counts["sign_test_p"]:.4f} |')
+    print(f'Selected variant: {selected}; exact_tie={b1 == b2}')
+    print(f'Protected existing files unchanged: {len(frozen)}')
+    generated = [p for folder in (NEW, DEST) for p in folder.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
+    with (DEST / 'FILES_SHA256.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
+        stream.write(json.dumps({str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(p) for p in sorted(generated)}, indent=2) + '\n')
+    for path in (Path(__file__), *sorted(NEW.rglob('*.json')), *sorted(DEST.rglob('*.json'))):
+        print(f'{path.relative_to(ROOT)} SHA-256: {sha(path)}')
+    for path in sorted(DEST.glob('*_responses.jsonl')):
+        print(f'{path.relative_to(ROOT)} SHA-256: {sha(path)}')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+        result['pairs'][f'{left} - {right}'] = {'mean_difference_all_100': mean(differences),
+                                               'bootstrap_95_ci': bootstrap(differences),
+                                               'nonempty_wins_ties_losses': wtl([differences[i] for i in nonempty])}
+    b1, b2 = mean(scores['B1']), mean(scores['B2'])
+    selected = 'B2' if b2 > b1 else 'B1'
+    result['selection'] = {'selected_variant': selected, 'criterion': 'higher all-100 mean nDCG@10; tie → B1',
+                            'B1_ndcg_at_10': b1, 'B2_ndcg_at_10': b2, 'exact_tie': b1 == b2}
+    sources = [PLAN, SOURCE / 'responses.jsonl', SOURCE / 'run_meta.json', SOURCE / 'run_provenance.json',
+               OLD / 'protocol.json', OLD / 'contexts.jsonl', NEW / 'protocol.json', NEW / 'contexts.jsonl',
+               ROOT / 'scripts/hw3_repeat_first.py', ROOT / 'starter.py']
+    result['source_sha256'] = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(p) for p in sources}
+    result['derived_response_sha256'] = {method: item['derived_response_sha256'] for method, item in scored.items()}
+    result['analysis_script_sha256'] = sha(Path(__file__))
+    check(all(sha(p) == expected for p, expected in frozen.items()), 'existing protected file changed')
+    result['protected_existing_files_checked_unchanged'] = len(frozen)
+    with (DEST / 'bench_select.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
+        stream.write(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
+    print('| Benchmark method | nDCG@10 all 100 | nDCG@10 nonempty | Nonempty users | Fallbacks | A seconds/user |')
+    print('| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |')
+    for name, row in result['methods'].items():
+        seconds = '—' if row['seconds_per_user'] is None else f'{row["seconds_per_user"]:.4f}'
+        print(f'| {name} | {row["ndcg_at_10_all"]:.4f} | {row["ndcg_at_10_nonempty"]:.4f} | '
+              f'{row["nonempty_truth_users"]} | {row["fallbacks"]} | {seconds} |')
+    print('| Pair | Mean difference | Bootstrap 95% CI | W/T/L nonempty | Exact sign p |')
+    print('| --- | ---: | --- | --- | ---: |')
+    for name, comparison in result['pairs'].items():
+        ci, counts = comparison['bootstrap_95_ci'], comparison['nonempty_wins_ties_losses']
+        print(f'| {name} | {comparison["mean_difference_all_100"]:.4f} | [{ci[0]:.4f}, {ci[1]:.4f}] | '
+              f'{counts["wins"]}/{counts["ties"]}/{counts["losses"]} | {counts["sign_test_p"]:.4f} |')
+    print(f'Selected variant: {selected}; exact_tie={b1 == b2}')
+    print(f'Protected existing files unchanged: {len(frozen)}')
+    generated = [p for folder in (NEW, DEST) for p in folder.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
+    with (DEST / 'FILES_SHA256.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
+        stream.write(json.dumps({str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(p) for p in sorted(generated)}, indent=2) + '\n')
+    for path in (Path(__file__), *sorted(NEW.rglob('*.json')), *sorted(DEST.rglob('*.json'))):
+        print(f'{path.relative_to(ROOT)} SHA-256: {sha(path)}')
+    for path in sorted(DEST.glob('*_responses.jsonl')):
+        print(f'{path.relative_to(ROOT)} SHA-256: {sha(path)}')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
